input_mode: Scripted ViewerActions only. Hardware keyboard/mouse messages, button states, accumulated deltas and cursor hover are discarded after Bevy InputSystems and before runtime Update controls. Native window/update settings are unchanged; the window may activate. This proof does not verify physical OS input delivery.
notes: Real native renderer. Original source records validated before app startup; OS bundle cache is warm. Acceptance is the first update observing the action ticket complete and loading false, before the three render-settlement frames. It includes action dispatch and worker publication, not screenshot work. Frame intervals are CPU update intervals, not GPU presentation latency. The bounded layout_job_timings records actual hit/miss/saved_exact/saved_repair decisions and matching action/revision IDs. Empty per-action layout_jobs means the action did not submit a layout job. Worker indexing, source lock wait, projection, restoration, solve and preparation residual are nonoverlapping; worker_total includes those stages. Publication wait, CPU acceptance, scene construction and save follow worker completion. These are CPU measurements and exclude deferred command application/GPU presentation. The cached step field is only an expectation; actual cache decisions are in layout_jobs. Cached geometry is compared exactly; all scenes are bounded to 250 representations.

persistence.scope: Synchronous main-thread state preparation and atomic save, including existing-state validation, serialization, file/directory fsync. Acceptance and frame intervals include this cost when enabled. The fresh temp directory is retained for inspection; no user state is read or written.

frame_trace_summary.scope: Opt-in CPU schedule boundaries and the unchanged pipelined renderer extract callback. render_join_and_extract includes waiting for the render world, main-thread render tasks, extraction and dispatch; it is not GPU presentation timing. between_updates and before_render_extract are residuals including event-loop/OS/other-subapp work, not proven sleep time. Residual metadata is sampled at the end; other phase metadata at the start. between_updates belongs to the frame it precedes. Screenshot CPU spans are nested, not additive, and have no focus/loading/action sample. All offsets share the proof start. Startup, current unfinished schedule and later shutdown are excluded. Boundary instrumentation adds overhead; window focus and update settings are unchanged.

surface_acquisition_summary.scope: CPU scheduling bracket before/after Bevy prepare_windows in the render schedule, including time to schedule either marker and concurrent render work. This is not exclusive function time or GPU time. It covers swapchain acquisition/reconfiguration for all extracted windows; a call may reuse an existing texture. Render invocation numbers are independent of main frame IDs. Correlate by shared-clock start/duration offsets. Markers add ordering constraints/overhead but leave prepare_windows and window settings unchanged.

long_pause_correlation.interpretation: The surface-acquisition scheduling bracket overlaps nearly the entire long renderer handoff. Separate aggregate sampling shows Metal nextDrawable/semaphore waits. This localizes the path to investigate; it does not establish exclusive function time, GPU presentation time, a root cause in OS/window occlusion, or a fix.

provenance.conditions: No OS stack sampler or screenshot capture during this run; phase/surface timing enabled, normal window/focus/update policy unchanged, warm supplied bundle file cache, fresh isolated persisted state. No user preview was restarted.
